resources.string: CRUX needs the microphone to hear your commands. It only listens when you tap the mic or, if enabled, after you say \"Hey CRUX\".

Always-on listening needs a foreground service with a visible notification, and permission to post that notification. CRUX only reacts to the exact phrase \"Hey CRUX\" — nothing else you say is processed until then.
Hey, I\'m CRUX. How can I help?
I don\'t know how to do that yet.
I don\'t have a number saved for %1$s. Add them in CRUX Contacts first.
Send \'%1$s\' to %2$s — do you want me to do that?
I didn\'t catch a yes or no, so I\'m cancelling that.
Say \"Hey CRUX\" to give a command. Tap to open CRUX.
